title: herakles config
description: Targets to probe, variables and labors (ordered step lists) run every interval.

interval.description: Pause between the start of two cycles of a target. Default 60s.

step_timeout.description: Time limit of each step. Default 10s.

transfer_timeout.description: Time limit of steps that upload a payload or verify a download (sha256/size). Default 120s.

user_agent.description: User-Agent of every request. Default identifies the traffic as synthetic.

vars.description: Variables shared by every target. Target vars override them.

targets.description: Environments to probe. Each runs in parallel, on its own, with its own variables.

labors.description: Scenarios run in order every cycle. When a required step fails, later labors are skipped; finalizers still run.

var.description: A variable source. Exactly one of value, file or env. Files and env are read again every cycle.

value.description: Literal value. Never put secrets here.

file.description: File to read, e.g. a mounted Secret. Always treated as secret; a trailing newline is trimmed.

secret.description: Mask the value in logs and errors.

name.description: Value of the target label on every metric.

safe.description: Skip every step marked mutating: the same labors probe production read-only.

ca_file.description: PEM bundle added to the system roots, read every cycle.

finalizer.description: Run at the end of every cycle, even when another labor failed (logout and the like).

finally.description: Cleanup steps that always run after the steps, whatever happened. A step whose variables are missing is skipped.

step.description: One step: core fields plus exactly one module key.

name.description: Value of the step label. Unique within the labor.

description.description: What the step does, shown in the log when it starts.

optional.description: A failure is recorded but the labor goes on.

mutating.description: The step writes; it is skipped on safe targets.

http.description: One HTTP request. Fails unless the status is 2xx or listed in assert.status.

capture.description: Variables to set from the response.

multipart.description: Form fields: a string, or a file with filename and value or payload.

payload.description: A synthetic file generated in memory and streamed, hashed on the fly.

as.description: Variable that receives {sha256, size} once uploaded: {{ .vars.<as>.sha256 }}.

secret.description: Mask the captured value in logs and errors.

status.description: Accepted status codes; replaces the 2xx default. [401, 403] checks a request is rejected.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 (hex) of the response body, e.g. {{ .vars.upload.sha256 }} or a captured value.

sha256_header.description: Response header holding the body's SHA-256: hex, base64, or sha-256 in Content-Digest/Repr-Digest/Digest.
